messages:
Maria (DevRel): @here launching redwoodctl v0.2.0 — community CLI + plugin system is live! https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwoodctl/releases/tag/v0.2.0 :tada:

Highlights:
- plugin registry + install/enable UX
- auth helpers (OIDC/KMS)
- new `redwoodctl init` templates for Hosted/Dedicated/Private
- telemetry is OFF by default; opt-in via `redwoodctl telemetry enable`

Breaking change: config schema bumped to v2. Quick migration:
```
# old config
name: my-app
project: default
# new config (v2)
metadata:
  name: my-app
  project: default
```
Run `redwoodctl migrate-config` to auto-convert or see release notes.

We're looking for community maintainers for the plugin registry and example templates — reply here if interested. Community call Thursday 2026-03-26 15:00 PT (signup link in release notes).
